options: Keep CI to the lock check (just diagrams-check) and render on your machine
Lift the AppArmor restriction on the disposable runner before rendering (Chromium's documented option 1; keeps Chromium's own sandbox)
Install Chromium's SUID sandbox on the runner (option 3)
question: How should CI run the pinned diagram render? Headless Chromium cannot start its sandbox on the ubuntu runner (AppArmor restricts unprivileged user namespaces on Ubuntu 23.10 and later).
recommendation: the first now; the second if you want CI to render, since the runner is thrown away after the job
